geeklist.title: 2025 Downsizing Auction - Just in Time for Xmas
geeklist.description:
My wife and I are looking to slowly downsize as well be retiring within the next couple of years. This includes slowly reducing the number of games I have, I'm going to start off with some games that either have never hit the table after purchase or haven't hit the table in a long time. Some are old vintage games, some I backed on Kickstarter, some I've collected over periods of time. There will also be other geeky items as well.
The auction works as follows: [c] - I'll cite an opening bid. If I decide I want a buy now price or soft reserve[b]*[/b], I'll state that as well - All bids are in even $1 increments. - For those that have them, [i]Buy Now becomes INACTIVE[/i] within (i.e. less than) $3 of the Buy Now price[b]**[/b]. - Local pick-up is an option. I am in the US NoVA/DC Metro area, specifically the Falls Church area. - For those living elsewhere, you will pay actual shipping costs. I will give you an estimate when the auction closes[b]***[/b]. - To make bids or to ask questions about a game, add these as comments to the game itself. - If you have general questions related to the auction itself, then add these as a comment to the list. - I will be monitoring both as best as I can; please give me a day or two to respond though as I'm not retired yet. 😜 - All payments will use PayPal to pmboos at yahoo dot c o m [b][i]OR[/i][/b] can be cash if picking up locally. [/c]
This auction will [b]end at 5pm (1700) US Eastern Time on Thursday, 15 December 2025.[/b]. Winning bidders are expected to have arranged a pick-up (if local) or made payment within 7 days of auction closure. Please do not bid if you don't intend to go through with the purchase. I also will be out of town mid-day 12 Dec to about mid-afternoon 15 December. I will check in, but please ask any questions related to the games itself before 12 Dec. I do my best to mail within a day or two of payment, often same day if received early enough.
The marketplace has reportedly become difficult to actually close a transaction. My intention is to still give BGG its 3% cut for sold items. So if that difficulty still persists I'll donate the 3% to BGG from the sales.
[b]*[/b]Soft reserve means that I [i]may consider[/i] a price below the soft reserve, but don't count on it. Meeting the reserve will guarantee you get the item.
I'll be adding the non-game geeky items tomorrow, Mon, 1 December 2025.
[b]**[/b]My rationale is it could now go over that price, so I'll let the market determine the price. If you think the Buy Now price is a good deal, it would be wise to use it before it gets within $3 of it.
[b]***[/b]I will quote prices based on the cheapest means possible via the US Postal System or maybe UPS using their online capabilities and an estimated weight. I will not use FedEx; there is no nearby FedEx office. For some more fragile or valuable games, I will ship Priority Mail only and will quote you extra insurance. If my quote is less than actual shipping, I will eat the cost since I made the mistake, though I might let you know what that loss is in case you feel kind enough to make it up. If my quote is over by $1 or more, I will refund you the amount rounded down to the nearest $1. The "change" in difference will help pay for the gas I will use going to and from the post office. (I'm not looking to make money off shipping.) If you want to know an estimate ahead of time, BGG gives you a good idea of size and plan on about 4 pounds per game and you will be in the ballpark. If a game is unusually sized or heavy, I'll make mention of it in the description.

This is for Strato Checkers in good condition and complete, box has a splt corner. I had corresponded with the designer’s daughter some years ago (due to an eBay purchase) and obtained some extra pieces for Strato Tac-Tics. I am including a complete set of these and the game already provided a booklet with the rules for it. The photos here on the geek are mine.
Opening Bid of $50 Soft Reserve of $85 Buy Now: $100
This is a large game and a bit on the heavier side... (I'd estimate about 6.5 pounds.)

And I of course have Strato Tac-Tics also. This is in very good condition as well. I will include a box of extra pieces I got from the designer’s daughter (though I'll probably use a different box).
